The '''720 light freighter''', also known as the '''Ghtroc 720''' or '''Class 720 freighter''', was a [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] manufactured by [[Ghtroc Industries/Legends|Ghtroc Industries]]. Though less popular than the competing [[YT-series/Legends|YT-series]], the Ghtroc 720 developed a following in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], where Ghtroc Industries was located, and thousands of the freighters remained in use even after the manufacturer went out of business.

==Characteristics==
[[File:Ghtroc720_layout.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Ghtroc 720 [[:Category:Technical drawing images|schematics]]]]
The Ghtroc 720 was 38 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long and could carry 135 [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]] of cargo in its two 55 cubic meter main holds. In stock configuration, a fixed double [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] was mounted above the slightly raised cockpit. A popular modification was to mount ventral and dorsal turrets to improve defenses.<ref name="PSG" /> A pair of docking tubes were located on the ship's rear, and each could contain an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]. The [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight]] engines were located between the docking tube. Like many light freighters, the Ghtroc 720 was often extensively modified for [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] purposes.

==Role==
The freighter was used to haul goods and supplies between Outer Rim manufacturing centers and outlying colonies.<ref name="PSG" />

==History==
One prominent Class 720 freighter was the [[Accuser (720 light freighter)|''Accuser'']], the personal [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of [[Tiss'shar/Legends|Tiss'shar]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Kal-tan-shi]], who took the starship from a target he was pursuing in the [[Lesser Plooriod Cluster/Legends|Lesser Plooriod Cluster]].

[[File:Ghtroc_escape.jpg|thumb|150px|A Ghtroc 720 escapes a [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]].]]

In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] used an extensively modified Ghtroc 720 while attempting to trace [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] soldiers to their source. The ship was rebuilt by the flight [[Technician/Legends|technician]] [[Gibbon Lightmoon]] to enable a [[Covert Shroud Maneuver|covert shroud]] maneuver, with the entire cargo bay area gutted to make room for Skywalker's [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]]. When caught in the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'''s]] [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]], Skywalker entered his X-wing's cockpit and [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destructed]] the freighter, escaping through a break-away ventral hull section while reflective debris from the freighter disrupted the tractor beam. Thrawn, though frustrated by Skywalker's escape, was impressed by both the flawless execution of the covert shroud and tractor beam operator [[Rejlii Mithel]]'s creative, though ineffective, attempt to thwart it.<ref name="LC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>
